name: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Kings of Hells: Leaf 27
summary: This leaf is part of a set depicting the Ten Kings of Hell. The theme transforms the Indian Buddhist view of judgment after death into a typical Chinese bureaucratic process.
